messages.subject: upcoming deadlines and next steps
parts:
I thought I would write to let everyone know about upcoming deadlines
and next steps.

Deadlines:

27 Mar Student Application Deadline
3 Apr All R mentors in melange
13 Apr Organization Slot Request Deadline (all scoring will be done)
27 Apr Accepted Students notified by Google
25 May GSoC coding officially starts

The Student Application Deadline is less than 24 hours away. Google's
deadlines are firm. Any student who does not have an application in the
system by the deadline cannot apply.Students shouldn't plan to be able
to edit their proposals after the proposal deadline.

By no later than 3 April, I would like to see all R mentors in melange,
and you should be commenting on proposals and marking yourself as a
possible mentor for applications that match your project ideas. See my
email from yesterday about the proper/approved use of public vs private
comments.

By 13 April, R must request slots from Google. That means that over the
next two weeks, all of the R mentors will be reading, commenting on, and
scoring proposals. During this period, students may receive public
comments from R mentors. Please try to be responsive to these comments
and questions, as we will be scoring and ranking student proposals on
melange 'behind the scenes'. In some cases, an R admin or mentor will
turn back on editing of a student proposal, if we feel that the answer
to a question will be more than would reasonably fit in a comment.

Between 13 Apr and 27 Apr, we will be working with Google to get and
allocate R's slots. We are prohibited from telling students if they
have been accepted or rejected during this time, as Google reserves that
right to themselves, and it can and often does change at the last
minute. Mentors, please don't violate this rule, as your project or
even R could be barred from GSoC. Students, please don't ask, we can't
tell you.

On 27 Apr, students will be notified whether their proposal has been
granted a slot or not.

27 Apr to 25 May is the 'community bonding period. We'll cover this in
more detail when the time comes.

I will have limited access to email next week, on the order of once per
day, but Toby and Virgilio should be around to answer questions on this
list.

Regards,

Brian

parts:
On Thu, 2015-03-26 at 22:08 +0200, Islam Tolan wrote:
> sir you said that I 3 April we must see all of us at mélange. how and
> when this will be also I need to ask if that I must comment on all the

We ask all R mentors to comment on and rate all proposals that they feel
qualified to do so on, using private comments to comment on the things
that should be only discussed among the mentors, and public comments for
things students should respond to, as I described in my note on public
and private comments yesterday, and my longer note from last week.

3 Apr is not a Google deadline. It an R org deadline. By the middle of
the scoring period, we need to have some idea of which student proposals
will likely drop out. One way that we can assess that is whether the
mentors are engaged, which means in melange and participating in the
ranking and commentary. In some prior years, we had only a few days
from the close of the application period to the slot request. Last
year, iirc, we had a week. This year, we have two weeks between the
application deadline and the slot request deadline, so given that it is
clear that not all mentors listed on the ideas wiki are in melange right
now, we need to give people notice that they need to get into melange.

Regards,

Brian
